pin.longFormSummary:
An adventure-themed family hotel near Lake Garda, with Arctic, Arabian, Jungle and Wild West rooms and an Egyptian-temple restaurant.

Family stay

The hotel has 100 themed rooms across four adventure settings. Its Egyptian-temple-style Tutankhamon Restaurant extends the theme beyond the bedroom. Select the exact room theme and confirm occupancy and cot availability when booking.

The hotel is outside Gardaland Park, with resort shuttle connections. Check the current operating calendar, park tickets and seasonal Blue Lagoon water-area access; do not assume every hotel package includes park admission.

Opening and development

The hotel was inaugurated on 28 May 2016. Contemporary trade coverage distinguishes earlier soft opening from full operation beginning on 1 June. Corriere del Veneto reported a EUR25 million investment in this hotel; that is development cost, not a nightly room rate.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22 from an opened Tripadvisor property snapshot (736 reviews). Rooms/Service/Location/Cleanliness/Value: 4.6/4/4.4/4.5/3.6 of 5, rounded to half points. Snapshots can lag live totals; the Gardaland page is an older 2025 snapshot. MICHELIN property-name searches and destination pages, and Forbes Berlin / Lake Garda directories, were checked without a verified distinction for these hotels (Castelnuovo MICHELIN lookup inaccessible). AAA geographic coverage excludes Germany and Italy. Acclaim remains unknown. Berlin’s excerpt is a firsthand dorm stay, not a review of the private family room; only month-level publication is supplied.

pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hybrid hotel beside Berlin’s East Side Gallery, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and nearby Ostbahnhof transport.

Family and budget stay

Book a private family room for your household, rather than an individual bed in a shared dorm. The property offers rooms with twin and bunk beds, a guest kitchen, laundry facilities and common areas. Confirm the exact layout, occupancy, bathroom arrangement and linen conditions for the room selected.

Ostbahnhof and the East Side Gallery provide a useful base for city exploring. This is practical hybrid-hotel accommodation: the opened guest-score snapshot is stronger for location than rooms, cleanliness or value, so compare its published scores and room details before booking.

Opening and booking

MEININGER confirms the hotel opened on 1 December 2017 with 245 rooms and 833 beds. Those are opening figures, not a claim about the current inventory. Compare a private room’s complete stay price rather than a dorm-bed lead rate; breakfast, parking, laundry and other extras depend on your booking.

Snapshots can lag live totals; the Gardaland page is an older 2025 snapshot. MICHELIN property-name searches and destination pages, and Forbes Berlin / Lake Garda directories, were checked without a verified distinction for these hotels (Castelnuovo MICHELIN lookup inaccessible). AAA geographic coverage excludes Germany and Italy. Acclaim remains unknown. Berlin’s excerpt is a firsthand dorm stay, not a review of the private family room; only month-level publication is supplied.
